title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-2026-02-27
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (working doc) - purpose: sync on go/no-go items, owners, and blockers for the 1.10 release window. Status: in_review. DO NOT treat as final; will update after Friday dry-run.

Attendees (planned): Aisha Rahman (owner), Jordan Lee (release eng), Priya Kapoor (prod infra), Samir Patel (serving runtime), Evan Ramirez (sre on-call), Maya Thompson (product).

Agenda:
- Quick status round (each owner 2 min)
- Go/no-go checklist review
- Known risks & mitigations
- Outstanding decisions and action items
- Dry-run kickoff plan and timeline

Go / No-Go checklist (current flags in parens)
1) Release artifact build: binaries, container images verified and signed (owner: Jordan Lee) - Status: GREEN - images pushed to staging registry, digest verified.
2) DB schema migration plan & rollback tested (owner: Priya Kapoor) - Status: YELLOW - migration script ready; rollback tested on staging, but performance impact on long-running transactions not fully validated.
3) Canary rollout and automated health checks (owner: Samir Patel) - Status: GREEN - canary pipeline configured, health checks (latency, error-rate) in Grafana. Thresholds need final thumbs-up.
4) Monitoring & alerting runbook updated (owner: Evan Ramirez) - Status: YELLOW - runbook updated but escalation contacts missing for partner infra. ACTION: Evan to populate contacts by 2026-03-01.
5) Load/capacity testing and autoscaling config (owner: Priya Kapoor) - Status: RED - 95th p95 token latency spikes observed under simulated traffic; suspected batching config mismatch. Blocker until investigation complete.
6) Secrets and KMS validation (owner: Jordan Lee) - Status: GREEN - KMS rotation plan verified for private deployments; hosted API keys rotated.
7) Compliance & audit trail (owner: Maya Thompson) - Status: GREEN - audit logs enabled for PII paths, Confluence checklist satisfied.
8) Rollback plan and cutoff times communicated (owner: Aisha Rahman) - Status: GREEN - plan drafted; T-3h cutoff for DB migrations documented.

Top risks (short)
- Risk 1: Capacity spike during staged rollout causing p95 latency > SLO. Mitigation: increase autoscaler thresholds temporarily and hold back percent for Canary. Owner: Priya.
- Risk 2: DB migration may cause long-tail transactions in corner cases. Mitigation: run additional staging migrations during low-traffic window and enable transaction timeouts; consider online migration variant if spikes persist. Owner: Priya.
- Risk 3: Missing on-call escalation for partner infra will slow incident response. Mitigation: Evan to confirm contacts.

Decisions needed (before Friday dry-run)
- D1: Approve increased autoscaler max for canary to avoid p95 spikes? (decision needed by 2026-03-02) - Owner: Priya + SRE lead.
- D2: Proceed with current DB migration script vs. staged per-tenant approach? (decision by 2026-03-03 morning) - Owner: Product + DB eng.

Outstanding blockers and notes
- Autoscaling investigation in progress (Priya). On staging, batch size config set to 64 causes burst queueing; reverting to 32 reduced p95 but increases cost. Need guidance on tradeoff.
- Load-testing results attached: summary in linked Grafana dashboard. Full raw data on S3: s3://redwood-release-data/1.10/loadtest-2026-02-25.csv (link in Confluence page).
- Compliance sign-off pending from Legal for EU customer subset (Maya to chase).

Action items (owner / due)
- Priya Kapoor: Complete autoscaler tuning and publish recommended config (due 2026-03-01).
- Jordan Lee: Finalize release image tags and update release manifest with digests (due 2026-02-28).
- Samir Patel: Validate canary health-check thresholds and add one synthetic test for long-tail latency (due 2026-03-01).
- Evan Ramirez: Complete runbook escalation contact list and run a drill with on-call (due 2026-03-01).
- Maya Thompson: Confirm Legal compliance sign-off for EU subset and add note to Confluence (due 2026-03-02).
- Aisha Rahman: Draft cutover timeline and communicate T-3h cutoff to stakeholders (due 2026-03-01).

Dry-run plan (Friday 2026-03-05)
- 09:00 - kickoff and state check
- 09:15 - run migration in staging with traffic shaping (monitoring team on standby)
- 09:45 - verify canary health, run synthetic tests
- 10:15 - rollback simulation and validate rollback steps
- 10:45 - post-dry-run retro and final go/no-go decision (stakeholders: eng leads, product, SRE, customer success)

Notes / quick comms
- Slack thread: #release-1-10 (please post short updates there).
- Confluence page (linked above) is source of truth for final runbook.
- If any item moves to RED before dry-run, escalate to me and we'll consider postponing.

Meeting prep checklist (what to bring to sync)
- Owners: be ready to report green/yellow/red and a 1-line mitigation if not green.
- Bring links to logs/dashboards and any short playback for incidents.
- Confirm action-item completion before dry-run.

Follow-ups after meeting
- I'll update this doc with final choices and push a short summary to #release-1-10 and email stakeholders (summary template in Confluence).

Quick timeline reminders
- Code freeze: 2026-03-03 23:59 PT
- Dry-run: 2026-03-05 09:00 PT
- Release window: 2026-03-07 02:00-06:00 PT

Questions for execs (if time)
- Do we want to accept the autoscaling cost hit in exchange for lower risk during rollout? (need explicit sign-off if >10% cost increase).
- Confirm escalation policy for partner infra incidents (who is authorized to approve increased capacity spend).

End of notes. Will iterate after Friday dry-run and capture final go/no-go decision here.
